title.value: Continuous iron spreading on carbon-shell composite nanotubes for electromagnetic wave absorption
title.justification: The title explicitly mentions the focus of the paper on a technique for electromagnetic wave absorption using nanotubes.
title.quote: Continuous iron spreading on carbon-shell composite nanotubes for electromagnetic wave absorption

analysis.description: This paper discusses the development of Fe@C composite nanotubes by introducing carbon onto precursor α-FeOOH fibers followed by hydrogen-thermal annealing. These nanotubes are studied for their electromagnetic wave absorption properties, achieving significant reflection loss, making them promising candidates for high-performance electromagnetic wave absorbing fillers.

type.justification: The paper involves experimental preparation and characterization of Fe@C composite nanotubes, including XRD patterns, Raman spectra, electromagnetic parameters, and other empirical data.
type.quote: In the current research, α-FeOOH fibers of nanometer scale, used as precursors, were prepared by liquid-phase co-precipitation…
